chapter: The Tristano group and leaving for Kenton
title: First marriage and children
summary: He married a high-school classmate shortly before joining Thornhill; he declines to discuss it or his daughter.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: Now that you mention this it’s a good time to ask you somewhere in this time period you got married, right?
When did you marry your first wife?
That was a short time before I joined the band, actually.
Before the Birth of the Cool band?
So you met her in Chicago?
Yeah, we went to high school together.
Do you want to talk about this?
Okay. How about talking about your kids, do you want to speak of your children just in passing since we mentioned Beck? That was your oldest daughter, Rebecca?
Is this something you want to talk about or should we just go back to the music?
That was a bit of a problem, I’d rather not talk about it.
